<title level="1" right="Rules">[Multiclass Archetypes](/Rules.aspx?ID=168)</title>

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 219 <sup>4.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
Archetypes with the multiclass trait represent diversifying your training into another class’s specialties. You can’t select a multiclass archetype’s dedication feat if you are a member of the class of the same name (for instance, a fighter can’t select the [Fighter Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=709) feat).
</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>
